guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Build Your Incentive Passport
guide.description: Install a Sui wallet first. Slush and Nabox both work across TBook’s products, and you will want a little SUI for gas. Then open the TBook engagement portal , connect the wallet, and link your X account and Discord. The Passport is the container every score writes into, so an incomplete profile caps everything downstream.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint Your WISE Credit Score
guide.description: Mint your WISE Credit Score from the same portal. It reads your linked wallets and accounts and grades you across four dimensions. Mint early, because the score accrues history and a profile built weeks before a snapshot outweighs one created that day.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete Campaigns and Collect SBTs
guide.description: Work through the active campaigns on the portal. Each issues a soulbound token on completion, and SBT holdings are a named eligibility category. Types rotate weekly: Prediction campaigns, where you commit to an outcome and mint an SBT on resolution X Spaces attendance drops and Engagement Basecamp quests Partner project campaigns run through TBook for other protocols
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund Your Wallet with USDC
guide.description: The vault takes USDC on Sui. Bybit lists USDC and supports direct Sui withdrawals, which skips bridging entirely. Already holding USDC elsewhere? Move it across with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit into the rcUSD Vault
guide.description: Open the TBook Vault and pick the rcUSD Vault, which routes deposits into the R25 Protocol. Deposits run from 1 USDC to 1 million with no fee, settlement is T+1, and you receive shares that appreciate as yield accrues rather than paying out separately. APY has recently sat above 8%.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint a Bookies NFT
guide.description: Bookies NFTs live on Sui at TBook’s NFT page. Holding one raises your Wealth Score and puts you in the airdrop category reserved for early supporters, the most direct eligibility upgrade here.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
